title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: The strongest radio leads found for 13–19 October are NET FM on FM 101 MHz, plus DAB+ directory listings for Radio Sportiva and BBC World Service. WorldDAB lists BBC World Service on Digi B Network block 6A at 181.936 MHz; reception at the hotel and event venue remains untested. The dated BBC Sportsworld listings and local stations’ recurring grids do not prove that a specific trip event or fixture will be carried.

records.name: NET FM — FM 101 MHz
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta
records.hours: NET FM’s recurring weekly grid lists Hits & Score on Saturday at 16:00 and Sports Box on Sunday at 15:00 (times as published by the Malta station; timezone not explicitly stated). In this trip window those days are 17 and 18 October. The same grid lists Mhux Premier biss on Friday at 18:30 (trip-window Friday is 16 October); see the separate net-fm-friday-mhux-premier-biss record for that lead.
records.description: The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list gives NET FM at 101 MHz FM. NET FM’s own recurring weekend grid includes two sports programmes. This is the clearest conventional-FM option found, but the weekly grid is not a date-stamped October 2026 schedule and does not confirm match commentary or carriage of a particular event.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026: NET FM’s official programme grid (https://netfm.com.mt/) lists Saturday 16:00 Hits & Score and Sunday 15:00 Sports Box; the frequency is from the Broadcasting Authority list (https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced). The grid also lists a Friday 18:30 show, ‘Mhux Premier biss’, tracked as the separate net-fm-friday-mhux-premier-biss record (schedule lead only; content unverified). The grid does not state its time zone and is recurring, not a date-stamped trip-week schedule. Recheck the station’s live schedule before travel. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed.

records.name: Radio Sportiva — DAB+ directory listing
records.area: Malta DAB+ directory; reception not tested at AX ODYCY or BLAST Arena Studios
records.address: Not published; the directory does not state a multiplex block or tuned frequency
records.hours: Radio Sportiva’s recurring grid lists Diretta Sportiva on Saturday and Sunday, 15:05–17:00. Its schedule page says programming may vary with the sporting events of the day. The date-specific live items shown when checked were for 5–11 October, not 13–19 October.
records.description: Digi B Network’s Malta DAB+ channel directory lists Radio Sportiva, an Italian sports station. Radio Sportiva’s own schedule lists weekend sports programming. The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations list does not show Radio Sportiva, and no DAB+ block or tuned frequency for it was found, so treat it as a plausible DAB+ option to scan for by name, not a reception test or a promise of live coverage of a named match.
records.notes: Re-checked 11 Oct 2026. Station schedule (https://www.radiosportiva.com/palinsesto/): “Diretta Sportiva” Saturday and Sunday 15:05–17:00; the page says programming can change with the day’s sporting events and that live programming can run until 24:00 depending on evening big matches (for example Serie A, Coppa Italia, European competitions, national team, or F1/MotoGP). Its dated “Sportiva Live” items visible at check time were for 5–11 October only. DAB+ channel directory (https://dab.com.mt/channels/) lists Radio Sportiva. Digi B’s channel profile (https://dab.com.mt/project/radio-sportiva/) is dated 20 August 2020. Times are as published; Italy and Malta share the same civil time during this trip.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required; hardware price not checked

records.name: BBC World Service — DAB+ listing and Sportsworld dates
records.area: BBC World Service appears in Malta’s DAB+ channel directory; reception not tested locally
records.address: Not published; this is a broadcast listing, not a visitor venue
records.hours: BBC’s official Sportsworld upcoming-broadcasts page, re-checked 11 October 2026, confirms episodes dated Saturday 17 October 2026 and Sunday 18 October 2026 on BBC World Service (except News Internet). The page labels displayed start times ‘Local time’, which depends on the viewer’s time zone: the 11 Oct check rendered 09:06 (Sat) and 10:06 (Sun), while the 10 Oct check recorded 13:06 and 14:06. The broadcast dates are confirmed; the exact start times, and their Malta-time equivalents, are treated as unsettled until re-checked with an explicit time-zone label.
records.description: The Malta DAB+ channel directory includes BBC World Service. The BBC’s dated programme listing schedules Sportsworld, described as live sport with news, interviews and analysis, on both playoff-weekend dates. The programme listing identifies the BBC World Service radio feed; a separate record gives WorldDAB’s DAB+ block/frequency listing. Neither directory evidence nor the programme schedule proves reception at the traveler’s locations or commentary on the trip’s esports, football, or sailing events.
records.notes: Malta DAB+ directory listing for BBC World Service: https://dab.com.mt/channels/. Dated BBC programme pages: Saturday 17 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0m2cw ; Sunday 18 October, https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c92ck0q313. The schedule labels the feed “BBC World Service except News Internet”; the episode page’s displayed local clock depends on the viewer’s time zone. WorldDAB’s technical listing and the reception caveat are recorded separately; no reception test at AX ODYCY or MFCC was available. Re-checked 11 Oct 2026: the BBC upcoming-broadcasts page (https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/p002w5vq/broadcasts/upcoming) explicitly bills the Sunday 11 October 2026 episode (https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/w1730c9208pxyf8) as “Live sport from around the world - including the English Premier League”, confirming that Sportsworld is the primary English-language DAB+ candidate for EPL coverage, while the 17/10/2026 and 18/10/2026 GMT episodes currently display the general synopsis without naming specific fixtures yet. Start-time discrepancy noted 11 Oct 2026: the 10 Oct check recorded 13:06/14:06 (then labelled GMT), while the 11 Oct check rendered 09:06/10:06 under the page’s ‘Local time’ label; because the displayed clock follows the viewer’s time zone, no definitive Malta start time is published here. Recheck the episode pages close to the dates and record the time with its explicit zone.
records.price range: Free-to-air broadcast; DAB+ receiver required for radio reception; hardware price not checked

records.description: No current AM or medium-wave sports station was confirmed. The Broadcasting Authority’s licensed-stations page (checked 11 Oct 2026) lists FM, DAB+ and community-radio services and no AM/MW station. A 2026 TVM News history says Radju Malta began on 999 MW and changed to 93.7 FM in 1979; that historic reference is not evidence of a current AM service.
records.notes: The current Broadcasting Authority licensed-stations list was checked on 11 Oct 2026 (https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced). Absence from the list is not a guarantee that no distant AM signal can ever be received; do not rely on an AM sports programme without current station confirmation. Historical context: https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/radju-malta-is-53-years-old/.

records.name: BBC Radio 5 Live / 5 Live Sports Extra — Premier League commentary listings
records.category: UK national radio — football listing (Malta reception not verified)
records.area: United Kingdom BBC service; reception or streaming in Malta not established
records.hours: The BBC's upcoming-broadcasts page, checked 11 Oct, shows Premier League commentary with the labels 'Today', 'Next Saturday' and 'Next Sunday' and no calendar date for those items. The dated entries shown are Sat 24 Oct (14:55, 15:00, 17:30 UK time) and Sun 25 Oct (14:00, 16:30 UK time), which fall after the trip. Malta is one hour ahead of UK time in this period (CEST, UTC+2, versus BST, UTC+1).
records.description: The BBC's Premier League Football programme page lists live 5 Live and 5 Live Sports Extra commentary for 2026–27 fixtures. It is a UK public-broadcaster listing. It is not a Malta frequency, DAB+ block, or streaming-availability check, and it does not confirm that the feed can be received in Malta or that any named fixture is broadcast on 17–18 October.
records.notes: The 'Next Saturday' and 'Next Sunday' entries are not mapped to 17–18 October in the snapshot checked; that mapping is an inference and must be confirmed on the BBC page on the day. BBC Sounds/stream access from Malta was not tested and must not be assumed. The user's 'Kalshi-market' framing was not verified: no Kalshi market, EPL fixture set for 13–19 October, or Malta broadcast-rights deal was checked. Third-party TV listings (not radio) show Premier League rights for Melita/GO TSN channels; they were not used as radio evidence.
records.price range: Not applicable (listing); receiver and streaming costs not checked

records.name: NET FM — Friday 18:30 ‘Mhux Premier biss’ slot
records.area: Nationwide licensed FM service in Malta (FM 101 MHz)
records.hours: NET FM’s recurring Friday grid lists 18:30 ‘Mhux Premier biss’ (time zone not stated). Friday 16 October 2026 is inside the trip window; the programme’s content for that date is not confirmed.
records.description: NET FM’s published Friday schedule includes an 18:30 programme titled ‘Mhux Premier biss’ (Maltese for roughly ‘not only the Premier’). The title suggests Premier League talk, but the format, presenters and whether it carries live match commentary were not verified. Treat it as a schedule lead only.
records.notes: Schedule from NET FM’s own grid, checked 11 October: https://netfm.com.mt/ . Frequency from the Broadcasting Authority: https://ba.org.mt/stations-licenced . The grid is recurring, does not state a time zone and is not a dated 16 October 2026 programme listing. It is not a confirmed football commentary broadcast.
